tweet.text:
I built GridCore: a scheduler that lets several local LLMs share one GPU.

Chat always goes first, background jobs yield, and a model loads only if its memory fits. It sits in front of llama.cpp and speaks the OpenAI API.

Linux and Apple Silicon, MIT.
https://github.com/w512/GridCore
